status_definitions.verified_snippet: Official page located and reviewed; only the notes are indexed, not a complete qualification specification.
status_definitions.discovery_pending: System identified but exact official source not yet reviewed.
status_definitions.catalogue_verified: Official subject catalogue reviewed; this does not imply full syllabus, paper structure or grade rules have been ingested.
status_definitions.specification_verified: Specific official subject specification reviewed for the stated qualification and version.
status_definitions.historical_reference: Official historical source useful for context but not current requirements.

policy.answer_rule: Do not infer subject-specific paper structures, grade thresholds, equivalencies or current-year rules from a general landing page. Cite sources and state when details remain unverified.
policy.copyright_rule: Store concise factual notes and links; do not reproduce full syllabuses or copyrighted examination papers.
policy.grade_calculation_rule: Raw percentage is earned marks divided by maximum marks. Never convert raw percentages to board grades unless the exact official grading table matches board, qualification, subject and examination session.

sources.qualification: IGCSE, O Level, AS & A Level
sources.title: Our awarding standards
sources.summary: Official explanation of Cambridge grade-threshold setting and awarding standards.
verified_notes: Cambridge uses statistical evidence from current and previous comparable candidate groups and expert judgement about paper difficulty when setting grade thresholds.
The page states that grading decisions are made by experts and reviewed by a second expert team, rather than being decided automatically by a computer.
Evidence is considered for each qualification component because assessments can test different skills and have different candidate populations.
sources.limits: Not a subject syllabus and does not provide a universal fixed percentage for a grade. Check the exact qualification, component and examination series.

sources.title: About Pearson Edexcel International GCSEs
sources.summary: Official overview of Pearson Edexcel International GCSE.
verified_notes: Pearson describes International GCSE as an international qualification with content and assessment designed for international learners.
Pearson states that many International GCSE subjects offer a choice of linear or modular assessment; the applicable route must be checked for the individual subject.
sources.limits: Overview does not replace the current subject specification or grading documents.

sources.title: FBISE Syllabus and Model Question Papers
sources.publisher: Federal Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education
sources.summary: Official FBISE portal for syllabus, schemes, model papers and assessment resources.
verified_notes: The FBISE portal groups syllabus and model-question-paper resources under SSC and HSSC levels.
The portal states that it provides syllabus, scheme of studies, model papers and objective-type test items.
sources.limits: Identify class, subject, scheme/version and examination session before giving a detailed answer.

sources.title: WASSCE entry regulations
sources.summary: Official WAEC Nigeria page describing WASSCE entry regulations.
verified_notes: The current page describes a minimum of eight and maximum of nine subjects for the candidate cohort covered by the notice.
The page notes that Citizenship and Heritage Studies and Digital Technologies require curriculum and syllabus development and are not to be examined until 2028.
The page states that 2026 and 2027 candidates sit English Language and General Mathematics as the two currently available core subjects, alongside selected other subjects.
sources.limits: Nigeria-specific and cohort/year-dependent; do not generalise to every WAEC member country.

sources.title: NECO SSCE Internal
sources.summary: Official NECO information for the internal senior school certificate examination.
verified_notes: NECO describes SSCE Internal as the examination for candidates in their final year of Senior Secondary School Education.
The page describes compulsory cross-cutting subjects and additional subjects based on specialisation, within the stated overall subject-count range.
sources.limits: Dates, fees and subject counts are session-specific. Read current-year guidelines.

sources.title: NECO SSCE External
sources.summary: Official NECO information for external/private candidates.
verified_notes: NECO describes SSCE External as an examination for candidates who are not in the school system.
The 2026 notice describes dual mode with computer-based and pen-and-paper options; candidates must consult the current session guidelines.
sources.limits: Mode, procedure, fees and dates are session-specific.

sources.title: Assessment and exams — Diploma Programme
sources.summary: Official IB Diploma Programme assessment overview.
verified_notes: The IB describes both external and internal assessment in the Diploma Programme.
The IB lists examinations, essays, structured problems, data-response tasks and other formats; internal-assessment examples include oral work, fieldwork, laboratory work and investigations.
sources.limits: Not a complete subject guide or diploma-award rulebook.

sources.title: AP Courses and Exams
sources.summary: Official College Board AP course and exam catalogue.
verified_notes: The College Board page provides course and exam information across AP subject areas.
Individual AP course pages are the appropriate next source for course-specific exam structure and assessment details.
sources.limits: A course catalogue is not a complete exam specification.

sources.qualification: National school curriculum and common written examinations
sources.title: MEB Frequently Asked Questions
sources.publisher: Republic of Türkiye Ministry of National Education
sources.summary: Official ministry FAQ with information about common written examinations.
verified_notes: The ministry FAQ describes the 2026–2027 implementation scope for the Common Written Examination System, including specified middle- and high-school grades and subjects.
sources.limits: Not a complete national curriculum or YKS guide.

sources.title: Curriculum & Compliance
sources.publisher: Punjab Education Curriculum Training and Assessment Authority
sources.summary: Curriculum & Compliance
verified_notes: PECTAA publishes curriculum and compliance resources, including Smart Syllabus and Accelerated Learning Programme materials for Grades 9 to 12.
The current page lists 2026–27 resources for Grades 9, 10, 11 and 12, including selected model papers and pairing schemes.
sources.limits: Provincial curriculum authority source; each BISE examination notice and subject specification still needs separate verification.

sources.title: BISE Lahore notifications and syllabus updates
sources.publisher: Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education Lahore
sources.summary: BISE Lahore notifications and syllabus updates
verified_notes: The official notification archive includes updated SSC and HSSC schemes and syllabuses for academic sessions, pairing schemes and model papers.
The archive identifies updated HSSC and SSC schemes for academic session 2025–2027.
sources.limits: Notification archive is an index; open the specific current notification and attachment before asserting subject-level details.

sources.title: SLO Based Model Papers for HSSC
sources.publisher: Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education Peshawar
sources.summary: SLO Based Model Papers for HSSC
verified_notes: The official HSSC model-paper page provides class 11 and class 12 subject resources.
Listed subjects include Biology, Chemistry, Computer Science, English, Islamiyat, Mathematics, Physics, Urdu and Pakistan Studies.
Resources include model papers, marking schemes and tables of specification.
sources.limits: HSSC model-paper collection, not the complete board-wide syllabus catalogue.

sources.title: BISE Malakand examination resources
sources.publisher: Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education Malakand
sources.summary: BISE Malakand examination resources
verified_notes: The official downloads page provides categories for SSC Grade 9 and 10 model papers, tables of specification and rubrics, and HSSC Grade 11 and 12 resources.
The page lists recent examination gazettes and previous question papers, including 2026 HSSC and SSC resources.
sources.limits: Use exact subject, class and examination year; older scheme PDFs may be superseded.

sources.title: Curriculum and Textbooks — Grades 1–10
sources.publisher: School Education Department, Government of Balochistan
sources.summary: Curriculum and Textbooks — Grades 1–10
verified_notes: The department page provides a grade-wise scheme of studies, curriculum and textbooks for Grades 1–10.

It identifies the Bureau of Curriculum and Extension Centres as curriculum developer/reviewer, the Balochistan Textbook Board as textbook producer and BEAC as the assessment body for Grade 5 and Grade 8.
The page describes year-versioned curriculum resources.
sources.limits: Covers school curriculum through Grade 10; it does not replace BBISE SSC/HSSC examination rules.

sources.title: HSSC Scheme of Studies
sources.summary: HSSC Scheme of Studies
verified_notes: The document describes an HSSC scheme with compulsory subjects and science, humanities and other group options.
The document states the revised scheme was implemented from September 2007 and was updated June 24, 2024.
sources.limits: Historical/reference scheme; do not use as proof of current 2026–27 subject availability without locating the latest replacement.

sources.title: Revised Reduced Syllabus — General Group optional subjects, 2025
sources.summary: Revised Reduced Syllabus — General Group optional subjects, 2025
verified_notes: The official 2025 notice identifies General Group optional subjects including Computer Studies, Islamic Studies, Islamic History, Arabic, Economics, Civics, Commercial Geography and Home Economics.
sources.limits: 2025 reduced-syllabus document for selected optional subjects, not a complete current BSEK subject catalogue.

sources.title: Reduced syllabus XI and XII — 2020–21
sources.summary: Reduced syllabus XI and XII — 2020–21
verified_notes: The document is a Sindh government notification for a condensed HSC syllabus for academic year 2020–2021.
It lists then-included subjects such as English, Urdu, Islamiat, Ethics, Biology, Computer Science, Chemistry, Mathematics and Physics.
sources.limits: Historical pandemic-era reduced syllabus only; never present as the current BIEK syllabus.

sources.title: AP Courses and Exams — 42 subjects
sources.summary: AP Courses and Exams — 42 subjects
verified_notes: The College Board AP catalogue lists course and examination information for 42 AP subjects.
Subject areas include arts, English, history and social sciences, mathematics and computer science, sciences, world languages, AP Capstone and career-focused courses.
sources.limits: Catalogue-level evidence only; individual course pages are required for exam structure and scoring.

sources.title: Ofqual guide for schools and colleges 2026
sources.publisher: Office of Qualifications and Examinations Regulation
sources.summary: Ofqual guide for schools and colleges 2026
verified_notes: The 2026 guide identifies AQA, OCR, Pearson and WJEC Eduqas as exam boards offering GCSE, AS and A-level qualifications regulated by Ofqual in England.
Exam boards develop and award qualifications against subject content and regulatory conditions.
sources.limits: England-specific overview; Wales and Northern Ireland have distinct qualification regulators.

sources.title: EGE subjects and examination information
sources.summary: EGE subjects and examination information
verified_notes: FIPI lists 15 EGE subjects: Russian, mathematics, physics, chemistry, history, social studies, informatics, biology, geography, English, German, French, Spanish, Chinese and literature.
Russian language and mathematics are mandatory for current-year graduates seeking the school-leaving certificate; other EGE subjects are selected by candidates.
sources.limits: Confirm examination year and subject specification before advising about exam structure or scores.

sources.title: EGE 2027 demonstration papers, specifications and codifiers
sources.summary: EGE 2027 demonstration papers, specifications and codifiers
verified_notes: FIPI publishes demonstration variants, specifications and codifiers defining the structure and content of EGE 2027 assessment materials.
The page provides subject-specific document sets, including Russian, mathematics, physics, geography, social studies, literature and foreign languages.
sources.limits: Retain year and document version for every indexed item.

sources.title: CBSE Curriculum
sources.summary: CBSE Curriculum
verified_notes: CBSE publishes separate secondary curriculum for Classes IX–X and senior secondary curriculum for Classes XI–XII.

The catalogue includes languages, mathematics, science, social science and electives such as accountancy, biology, biotechnology, business studies, chemistry, computer science, economics, geography, history, legal studies, mathematics, physics, political science, psychology and sociology.
sources.limits: Catalogue-level index; open exact class, subject and academic-session document before using subject-specific requirements.

sources.title: Cambridge IGCSE subjects
sources.summary: Cambridge IGCSE subjects
verified_notes: The official IGCSE subject directory lists subject names and syllabus codes, with separate variants for some subjects and languages.
sources.limits: Directory is a subject catalogue; verify current syllabus code and year for each subject.

sources.title: Cambridge International AS & A Level subjects
sources.summary: Cambridge International AS & A Level subjects
verified_notes: Cambridge states that schools can choose from 55 AS & A Level subjects.
The official directory lists subjects with syllabus codes and identifies some AS-only, A-Level-only and new subjects.
sources.limits: Directory is not a substitute for each current subject syllabus or component structure.

sources.title: International GCSE subject availability
sources.summary: International GCSE subject availability
verified_notes: Pearson publishes an International GCSE subject availability table for May–June and November examination series.
The current catalogue includes sciences, mathematics, languages, humanities, business, computing and other subjects.
Pearson states that many International GCSE subjects offer linear or modular assessment options.
sources.limits: Availability differs by examination series and subject; confirm current information manual and specification.

sources.title: Türkiye Yüzyılı Maarif Modeli — teaching programmes
sources.publisher: Republic of Türkiye Ministry of National Education
sources.summary: Türkiye Yüzyılı Maarif Modeli — teaching programmes
verified_notes: The official secondary curriculum portal lists programmes including biology, geography, religious culture and ethics, philosophy, physics, English, chemistry, mathematics, music, history and Turkish language and literature.
MEB states that updated programmes are implemented in stages by grade and academic year.
sources.limits: Curriculum directory; confirm applicable grade and implementation year. YKS is administered separately by ÖSYM.
